questions.stem: What does it mean when titration results are described as 'concordant'?

options.text: The results are all exactly the same
The results are all above 25 cm³
The results were obtained on the same day
The results agree closely, typically within 0.1 cm³ of each other

questions.explanation: Concordant results are those that agree closely with each other, typically within 0.1 cm³. Only concordant results should be used to calculate the mean titre. Anomalous results that fall outside this range should be discarded.
